description: Header file defining internal classes, enums, and functions for string formatting extensions in the Abseil C++ library, including classes for sink implementations, flags, and format specifiers.

classes.name: FormatRawSinkImpl
classes.description: Implements a sink that can be implicitly converted from types providing a flush hook.

classes.name: FormatSinkImpl
classes.description: Provides an abstraction for writing formatted string data, with buffering and padding support.

classes.name: FormatConversionCharInternal
classes.description: Internal enum and static constants representing format conversion characters.

classes.name: FormatConversionSpecImpl
classes.description: Represents format specifiers including flags, width, and precision.

methods.name: FormatConversionCharFromChar
methods.description: Converts a character to its corresponding FormatConversionChar enum.

methods.name: FormatConversionCharIsUpper
methods.description: Checks if a FormatConversionChar is uppercase.

methods.name: FormatConversionCharIsFloat
methods.description: Checks if a FormatConversionChar is a floating-point specifier.

methods.name: FormatConversionCharToChar
methods.description: Converts a FormatConversionChar enum to its character representation.
